##### Project general facts

Indabyo Heights is a new residential development by Reportage Properties, an international developer with a portfolio spanning the UAE, Turkey, Morocco, KSA, Egypt, Uganda and beyond. The building combines contemporary architecture with elegant façades, expansive glazing and a thoughtfully designed layout, setting a new benchmark for urban living. The project comprises one, three and four-bedroom apartments, along with exclusive penthouses featuring private terraces and panoramic views.

Residents enjoy access to a full range of shared facilities, including a state-of-the-art gym, a stylish welcoming lobby, a fully equipped business centre, a shared lounge area for socialising, and two dedicated elevators for smooth and convenient access to every floor. Secure basement parking adds further comfort and peace of mind.

Apartments are delivered unfurnished with full finishing: fitted kitchen cabinets and countertops, built-in wardrobes, elegantly tiled bathrooms, energy-efficient double-glazed windows, and satellite and fibre-optic connectivity — ready for a seamless move-in experience.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nyarutarama is one of Kigali's most prestigious and green neighbourhoods, known for its embassy residences, well-kept parks and tranquil atmosphere. The area has developed around a scenic lake informally known as Lover's Lake, which borders the Kigali Golf Club and is framed by leafy walking paths.

Green Hills Academy, an international school, sits within walking distance, while a short drive brings residents to the city's business district, MTN Centre, Kigali Convention Centre, Amahoro National Stadium, BK Arena and King Faisal Hospital. Lake Kivu and Kigali International Airport are also close by, making the location convenient for both everyday living and business travel.

Rwanda grants foreign buyers freehold ownership, simplifying property ownership for international investors. Kigali continues to see steady growth in rental demand, supported by a fast-growing economy and its standing as one of Africa's easiest cities for doing business, positioning Nyarutarama as an attractive location for long-term investment.
